تقتصروا (form VIII)
# تَقْتَصِرُوا (taqtaṣirū) /taq.ta.sˤi.ruː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِقْتَصَرَ (iqtaṣara)
# تُقْتَصَرُوا (tuqtaṣarū) /tuq.ta.sˤa.ruː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِقْتَصَرَ (iqtaṣara)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
